answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents utilize Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent locks a $10,000 bond. Second, the local hardware enclave generates a unique, non-replicable signature. Third, the network validates this signature against the staked collateral. To launch a Sybil attack, an adversary must deploy $10,000 per identity and endure 48 hours of hardware verification. This barrier protects the digital garden. It is like planting rare saffron where every single seed is encased in a heavy copper shell to prevent any counterfeit growth from taking root.
